Green here: command-registry 8, cli/twining 19, tools 19/22, plugin-tool-references 20, context/graph/coordination-tools 45, dashboard 167, integration 75/90, deep-review-regressions 8, housekeeping-preview 12, triage-engine 70, record unit + blackboard-resolve + analytics 100, embedder/search/sqlite/record-sync 76, plugin-bundle 4, server-startup 4, cli/dispatch 4.
Environmental failures ONLY (git unusable in this sandbox): tools.test.ts 3, integration/tools/housekeeping-tools.test.ts 15, cli/validate-records.test.ts 2 — all die at `git init` before any Twining code runs.

Extra evidence executed: normalized comparison of all 39 registry descriptions (12,435 chars) and every schema key against the COMMITTED 2.16.1 bundle plugin/server/twining-server.mjs — exact match, which is the strongest available proof of description/schema neutrality given git cannot diff here. esbuild bundles both src/index.ts and src/cli/twining.ts with 0 errors / 0 warnings (probe output only; plugin/server/ untouched).

Open for the lead: (1) the plugin ships the MCP server bundle, not the CLI — a plugin-installed Twining has no `twining` bin; the CLI bundles to ~766 KB if we want to ship it. (2) twining_record's once-per-process quality nudge can fire on every CLI invocation. (3) the CLI dispatches full-surface commands regardless of tools.full_surface (deliberate; capabilities reports `surface`).
